newResearchAuthorization: User explicitly replaces unavailable v4 continuation with new LONG-only continuation; this is NOT unchanged v5
bar5Rule: First completed trading CLOSE<0 DEFENSIVE; reclaim CLOSE>=0 through bar5 RECOVERED; otherwise exitbar5; no v4

continuations.BAR5_FIXED12: Hold to inherited12 trading-bar cap after nonadverse/reclaim. Ablation/control and simplest candidate.
continuations.BAR5_TWO_LOWER_CLOSES: Exit second consecutive strictly lower completed CLOSE after continuation activation; equality resets, reclaim resets. Single2-confirm assumption to avoid one-bar flip.
continuations.BAR5_CLOSE_PEAK_HALF: Exit completed CLOSE<=half maximum observed completed CLOSE return since continuation activation, positive peak required. One symmetric50% retained-gain assumption, no fitted ratio.

capProvenance: Existing Fixed future.slice(0,12) baseline; same calendar-known shorter session cap. No holding-grid search.
execution: Completed-close reference-price marking for EVERY arm; decision at completed bar; NO guaranteed fill or broker realized PnL claim. Execution latency/slippage gate remains for integration.
missing: Censor if missing before exit; never use availability to decide exit. Complete-case common-arm set only for primary comparison, all277 retained.
sessionEnd: Reference diagnostic only when prior path is complete; unresolved15:25 auction excluded/censored with no substitution. Not a blocker for12-bar comparison.
selectionRule: For3 candidates only, rank each metric (higherbetter after transformation), minimize weighted rank loss; tail / winner preservation prioritized; ties use candidates order simplicity. No net-sum objective. All choices development-exposed, weights design judgments not precision guarantees.
winnerDefinition: Available MFE over common Fixed12-or-calendar path; positive final net preservation and >=level realization separately. Not full-session or independent opportunity proof.
concentration: lowerTop3 share of positive paired improvements; no positive improvement worst score. Report largest improvement removed.
adaptationLimit: Exactly3 predeclared candidates once. No follow-up grid, no result-driven family expansion.
